sources.title: Official DeepSeek-OCR release history
sources.evidence: The release section announces DeepSeek-OCR2 on 2026-01-27, earlier than the January 28 arXiv paper.

sources.title: DeepSeek-OCR 2: Visual Causal Flow
sources.evidence: The exact-model technical report identifies DeepSeek-AI authors, describes DeepEncoder V2 and the MoE decoder, and labels the retained decoder nominally 3B with about 500M active parameters. This is a decoder component disclosure, not a complete multimodal active count.

sources.title: Official DeepSeek-OCR-2 model card
sources.evidence: The original model card publishes weights and text-prompt/image inference examples for free OCR and grounded document-to-Markdown conversion. It lists the per-image visual-token budget as 256 plus up to six 144-token crops.

sources.title: Official checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Configuration sets max_position_embeddings=8192, 12 language layers, first_k_dense_replace=1, 64 routed experts, 2 shared experts, and 6 routed experts per token. It uses a SAM/Qwen2 vision stack and an 896-to-1280 linear projector; use_mla=false.

sources.title: Official weight repository Apache 2.0 license
sources.evidence: The actual LICENSE.txt distributed with the original weights is Apache License, Version 2.0; this agrees with model-card metadata.

sources.title: Official checkpoint safetensors header
sources.evidence: Two bounded HTTP 206 byte-range requests (0-7 and 8-335159) retrieve the 335152-byte JSON header, not weight payloads. Its 2707 BF16 tensors contain 3389119360 learned elements. Exact key coverage matches the official index; code inspection identifies learned positions, queries and separator and no stored buffers or quantization scales.

sources.title: Official DeepEncoder V2 implementation
sources.evidence: The SAM positional tensors are explicit learned Parameters. Qwen2-0.5B is instantiated with 24 layers, then its token-embedding table is deleted; learned 144- and 256-query embeddings are added. Thus the released causal encoder has 358256512 parameters, rather than retaining all nominal Qwen2-0.5B parameters.

sources.title: Official OCR2 multimodal implementation
sources.evidence: The released model combines SAM, Qwen2 vision encoder, linear projector and learned view separator with the language decoder. Vision runs on prefill; the inference interface accepts images and text and emits generated text. No dedicated thinking control or tool-schema interface is documented here.

sources.title: Official OCR2 language decoder implementation
sources.evidence: The decoder implementation has learned MoE gates/experts and untied text embedding/output-head modules. Rotary caches and inverse frequencies are registered as nonpersistent buffers and are absent from the checkpoint header.

sources.title: Official OCR2 tokenizer configuration
sources.evidence: The tokenizer has no chat_template and inherits tool-call special tokens. Token presence alone does not establish trained or supported native function calling; the supplied model card and OCR inference instructions do not document such support.

sources.title: Official repository metadata and checkpoint summary
sources.evidence: The original repository was created on 2026-01-27. Its reported revision is aaa02f3811945a91062062994c5c4a3f4c0af2b0 and safetensors total is 3389119360 BF16 elements, independently matching the bounded-header sum.

sources.title: Official checkpoint index
sources.evidence: The index references one safetensors shard and exactly the 2707 tensor keys present in its header. Index metadata.total_size is inconsistent with the actual header tensor-byte sum, so the count uses tensor shapes rather than index file-size arithmetic.

name.note: Official model title; normalize the baseline spelling to include the published hyphen.

developer.note: Published by the official deepseek-ai account and attributed to DeepSeek-AI in the technical report.

family.note: Normalized family key for the explicitly identified DeepSeek-OCR successor.

release_date.note: The developer explicitly dates its announcement January 27; repository creation corroborates it. January 28 is the later paper date.

open_weights.note: Original model weights are publicly downloadable from the developer-owned repository under its supplied license.

license.note: Read the actual license accompanying OCR2 weights. Do not transfer the earlier DeepSeek-OCR repository MIT license.

parameters_b.note: Complete learned checkpoint count: 3389119360 parameters / 1e9. Includes text embeddings/head, all routed/shared experts, both vision components, learned query/position embeddings, projector and view separator. All 2707 tensors are BF16 learned tensors; no quantization scales or persistent buffers are counted. Header range and component arithmetic are cached in /tmp/model-audit-167/parameter-summary.json.

active_parameters_b.note: No single full-multimodal active count is defined. The paper gives about 0.5B for the language decoder alone; vision runs separately during image prefill. Preserve that nominal component/phase disclosure in proposed_fields without applying it to the whole model.

architecture.note: Multimodal encoder/projector/decoder Transformer with a sparse MoE language decoder, not dense: 64 routed experts, 6 selected per token, 2 shared experts, and one initial dense layer. Dense SAM and Qwen2 vision components do not change the decoder classification.

context_window.note: The original language-model configuration explicitly sets 8192 positions. The separate 256–1120 visual tokens per image describe the image encoder budget, not context length; Qwen2 visual-encoder internal positional capacity is also not the decoder context.

modalities.note: Primary examples accept image input with textual OCR instructions and generate text/Markdown. PDF workflows rasterize pages; no native audio or video modality is established.

reasoning.note: The paper discusses causal visual reasoning as an architectural mechanism. It does not specify a native user-facing thinking/reasoning mode, separate reasoning output, or control; the OCR inference interface does not establish one. Clear the catalog-only false assertion rather than treating architecture wording as such a mode.

tool_call.note: No native tool/function-calling interface or training capability is documented for this OCR checkpoint. Inherited tool tokens are insufficient to confirm support or its absence; clear the catalog-only false assertion.

description.value: Open-weight OCR vision-language model that combines DeepEncoder V2 with a mixture-of-experts language decoder for text extraction and grounded document-to-Markdown conversion.
description.note: Replace the unqualified high-accuracy claim and broad scenario list with the demonstrated model structure and documented OCR/grounded conversion tasks.

patch.name: DeepSeek-OCR 2
patch.description: Open-weight OCR vision-language model that combines DeepEncoder V2 with a mixture-of-experts language decoder for text extraction and grounded document-to-Markdown conversion.
patch.notes: Complete released checkpoint: 3.38911936B learned parameters, including vision encoder, projector and language decoder. The paper reports approximately 0.5B active parameters for the language decoder only; whole-model activation varies by processing phase. Configured decoder context is 8192; the 256–1120 tokens per image are a separate visual budget. Native thinking mode and tool calling are not established by the developer materials.

sources.label: Official repository metadata and checkpoint summary

summary: Audited all 14 fields against primary materials. Add the complete 3.38911936B learned checkpoint total, MoE architecture, Apache-2.0 license and DeepSeek-OCR family; confirm January 27 release and 8192 decoder context. Preserve the paper's nominal decoder-only active disclosure separately. Native thinking and tool calling remain undisclosed; both catalog-only negative assertions are cleared. Exact component counts and source cache are in /tmp/model-audit-167.
